name: Cardamom
summary: One of the world's most versatile spices — sweet, camphor-like, and floral. Equally at home in chai, coffee, biryanis, and Scandinavian bakes.
description: Green cardamom pods contain tiny black seeds with a warming, eucalyptus-like fragrance. Always buy whole pods and crack them fresh — pre-ground cardamom loses its character within weeks. Black cardamom (a different species) is smokier and used primarily in savoury cooking. Cardamom is defined by a tension between its sweetness and its cooling, almost menthol quality, making it uniquely adaptable across sweet and savoury applications.

pairings.note: A Persian classic — the combination anchors many rice and dessert traditions from Iran to India.
Together they form the warm spine of many spice blends including ras el hanout and garam masala.
